title: Improve Intro Air Movement
summary: Reworked Beat3_Konvektion air exchange: true buoyancy paths (warm rises/exits top of gap, cold sinks/enters bottom), simultaneous warm+cold streams via new animate_flows, streak particles aimed along the path, denser looping, and a glowing tracked Luftpaket while the exchange keeps circulating. animate_flow now delegates to animate_flows so Cooling/Heating callers get streaks too.
